utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Can you hear me? Right, Thursday the twelfth. Let's get through the board.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, loud and clear. Unlike the broken coffee machine in the canteen. That's just making a sort of angry bubbling noise now.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Still better conversation than you before your first coffee.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Cheers. Also, whose new car is that in the car park? Very brave, parking something that shiny next to this place.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one with half the county stuck to the wheel arches.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Never mind the car, the heating in the portakabin's either tropical or completely off. I'm sat here in my coat. Just having a moan, before that goes on the board.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Mine's still on too. Teams makes it look like we're meeting outdoors.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before we become the weather report—finished work first.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, so, finished the repair on the Gas Turbine 1 last night. That's done, not something rolling into today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, that one's closed.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the line three on Tuesday. Still showing in the old notes, but it's finished.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Same with line two. Tested the line two yesterday and it's all fine now. Nothing outstanding from that test.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Those are history, then. Anything else we need to understand before the actual jobs?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Um, I saw the pressure on the turbine one gas valve dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own. Just an observation.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: It settled again, did it? Not still sitting low?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, back where it was. I'm not raising a separate job off that here.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: The existing HV switchboard work is still blocked, though. Can't get to the HV switchboard until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And I can't get to the Site Water System until production gives us a window either. Same access problem, both still waiting.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Both remain blocked, not fresh commitments for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: What about the purchase order for the feedwater pump? That still needs chasing, doesn't it?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll chase the purchase order for the feedwater pump by the 28th. It's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Right, the order chase, rather than saying the pump itself will be here by then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Aisha has the chase, by the 28th. Fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll sort the training records for the new starters by end of day. No rush on that one; it doesn't need to jump ahead of the plant jobs.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Okay, Saz for the training records. End of day, no rush.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. That's mine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fi, can you go to Harbour Road to pick up the replacement parts for the line 1 hydraulics today at 2pm? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll go to Harbour Road and pick up the replacement parts for the line 1 hydraulics. Today at 2pm works.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Just the collection we're talking about, yeah? Not fitting them as part of that.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just collection. Normal priority, today at 2pm. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha Begum, can you do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the turbine two water valve today at 2pm? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yes, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the turbine two water valve today at 2pm. Understood, it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—the turbine two water valve, not the gas valve we just mentioned?

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: That's right, turbine two water valve. Separate job from that pressure observation.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Olu, can you check the guarding on the Main Outfeed Conveyor? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll check the guarding on the Main Outfeed Conveyor. Got that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Guarding check only, as it's written there?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, checking the guarding. Not signing myself up for a load of alterations off the back of this call.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Correct. It matters but it's not urgent, and there's no deadline attached to that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tomasz, can you clear the jam and check the sensors on the Palletiser this afternoon? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the Palletiser this afternoon. Properly isolated for the jam clearance, obviously.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: The sensor check's included as well, then? Not just getting the trapped bit out.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, both. Clear the jam and check the sensors, not just pull it out and call it done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. This afternoon, Tomasz. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: PR, can you inspect the main water valve for leaks by Wednesday?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yes, I'll inspect the main water valve for leaks by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And just to keep the notes straight, that's the main water valve inspection, separate from the blocked Site Water System work I mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, separate entries. We're not treating the blocked work as released.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: One without a name against it: someone needs to do a site visit at Tollgate Water Treatment Works with the contractor tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, no rush on that one in priority terms, but the visit is tomorrow at 9:30. Anyone taking it?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'm not putting my name against that. Don't count me as covering it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, I'm not volunteering for that one either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay... nobody's taken the site visit at Tollgate Water Treatment Works. It needs doing, but it stays unowned. No rush, tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Fine. Blank owner, then. Raising it wasn't me offering to go.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Dangerous pause, that. In these meetings a pause normally means you've volunteered.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Or your Teams has frozen. Equally binding, apparently.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Not on my board. Right, quick check that I've not mangled anyone's commitments.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Mine's the Harbour Road pickup for the line 1 hydraulics, today at 2pm, normal priority. That's right.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Both mine are right: the urgent turbine two water valve sign-off today at 2pm, and the fairly important feedwater pump purchase order chase by the 28th.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: And mine's the main water valve leak inspection by Wednesday. The access blockers are still blockers.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Guarding on the Main Outfeed Conveyor for me. Matters, not urgent. All good.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Palletiser jam and sensors this afternoon for me. Not an emergency, but won't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll sort the new starters' training records by end of day, no rush. That's everything agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: The contractor visit remains unowned, just so there's no assumption someone's silently picked it up. Thanks, everyone.
